_comment: Off-centre asymmetric pin-cell variant. fuel is shifted by (+0.10, -0.08) cm so mirror x/y are non-trivial (mirror x flips y_offset sign, mirror y flips x_offset sign). The pin extent stays at 1.30 cm — OpenMOC's CPUSolver exhibits its own convergence pathology at larger pin extents (1.50 cm) so we keep the cell tight. Offsets chosen large enough that clamp-positive mutations produce >1e-5 (MOC) and >3·σ (MC) k_eff shifts but small enough that OpenMOC's power iteration stays in the good basin.
